items.claim: Jose Montana's wrestling is very poor.
items.quote: The wrestling is god awful for this Brazilian.

items.claim: Jose Montana has a suffocating top game and a nice head and arm choke.
items.quote: The jiu-jitsu is nice. His top game suffocating... He's got a nice head and arm choke.

items.claim: Louis Sutherland has shown the ability to win a sloppy fight with striking.
items.quote: Louis Sutherland has shown a little bit of a capability to bang. He was able to beat Taiu to Avasa in a sloppy fight.

items.claim: Louis Sutherland is not high level or good, and is less jacked than previously.
items.quote: He's not high level. He's not good. He's not as jacked as he used to be.

items.claim: Bruno Lopez is a decent striker with a heavy low kick.
items.quote: He is a decent striker. He makes it exciting. He's got a heavy low kick

items.claim: Dr. Nurgazai has a southpaw stance and good kicks set up to the head.
items.quote: Dar Nurgazai southpaw, he should shut that [__] down. Dar Dargasai's got some nice kicks that he sets up to the head.

items.claim: Dr. Nurgazai is more durable than Bruno Lopez and has questionable chin concerns for Lopez.
items.quote: I think that durability is a big deal... I don't trust the chin of Bruno Lopez.
this dude used to be 500 pounds.

items.claim: Ty Miller is a great striker with a significant height and reach advantage.
items.quote: Ty Miller is a great striker for a seven and0 kid... tall lanky striker should have a massive advantage there.

items.claim: Billy Ray Goff has been gone from competition for over a year.
items.quote: Billy Ray Goth is back. He's been gone for over a year.

items.claim: Alexia Tyanara takes everyone down, whereas Amanda Lamos frequently gets taken down.
items.quote: Alexia Tyanara's takes everybody down and Amanda Lamos is always getting taken down.
